features: Cloudflare clearance is live — the episode list now loads from AnimePahe: when you open a detail page, the app solves the site's security check in a hidden browser view on your own phone and reuses that session for episode lists and downloads (no server, no account, nothing leaves the phone)
If the security check ever needs a tap, the app shows AnimePahe's own page once so you can tap the checkbox yourself, then carries on — instead of failing silently
fixes: Downloads no longer fail with 'session not ready' when the Pahe session expired — the app silently re-solves the check before resolving a download, and Retry on a failed episode list drops the dead session and solves fresh
